build_llava_model: build a LLaVA multimodal model with vision encoder and language encoder for image captioning
predict_llava_caption: predict image captions using the LLaVA model with a batch of input images
predict_llava_vqa: predict visual question answering answers using the LLaVA model on input images
preprocess_text_llava: preprocess text prompts by tokenizing and padding them for the LLaVA language model
post_process_llava: post process generated token outputs by decoding and assigning predictions to data samples
